data_source_note: Counts are areal-weighted aggregations of ACS 5-year 2023 block-group demographics intersected with the venue's walking/biking isochrone. Housing is heavily rental and multifamily (56% renter, 31% multifamily units) — the typical resident here is a renter, not an owner.
